tables.name: procurement.purchase_orders
tables.fact_owner: Approved supplier commitment before stock, payable, ITC, or accounting.

checks.name: ck_purchase_orders_status
checks.expression: status IN ('draft','submitted','approved','partially_received','received','cancelled')

checks.name: ck_purchase_orders_money
checks.expression: subtotal>=0 AND discount_total>=0 AND charges_total>=0 AND gst_taxable_total>=0 AND cgst_total>=0 AND sgst_total>=0 AND igst_total>=0 AND cess_total>=0 AND grand_total>=0

checks.name: ck_purchase_orders_approval
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('approved','partially_received','received') OR (approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_orders_net_gst_totals
checks.expression: net_value_total>=0 AND gst_taxable_total>=0 AND gst_taxable_total<=net_value_total

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_orders_document_discount_kind_basis
checks.expression: document_discount_kind IN ('none','percent','amount') AND document_discount_basis IN ('taxable_value','price_value')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_orders_document_discount_value
checks.expression: (document_discount_kind='none' AND document_discount_value=0) OR (document_discount_kind='percent' AND document_discount_value>=0 AND document_discount_value<=100) OR (document_discount_kind='amount' AND document_discount_value>=0 AND document_discount_value=round(document_discount_value,2))

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_orders_supply_type
checks.expression: supply_type IN ('intra_state','inter_state','import','sez')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_orders_zero_rated_payment_mode
checks.expression: zero_rated_payment_mode IN ('not_applicable','without_payment','with_igst') AND ((supply_type='sez' AND zero_rated_payment_mode IN ('without_payment','with_igst')) OR (supply_type<>'sez' AND zero_rated_payment_mode='not_applicable'))

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_orders_rounding_policy
checks.expression: rounding_policy IN ('none','nearest_rupee') AND ((rounding_policy='none' AND rounding_adjustment=0 AND grand_total=net_value_total+(CASE WHEN tax_charge_mechanism='normal' THEN cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total ELSE 0 END)) OR (rounding_policy='nearest_rupee' AND grand_total=round(net_value_total+(CASE WHEN tax_charge_mechanism='normal' THEN cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total ELSE 0 END),0) AND rounding_adjustment=grand_total-(net_value_total+(CASE WHEN tax_charge_mechanism='normal' THEN cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total ELSE 0 END)) AND abs(rounding_adjustment)<=0.50))

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_orders_tax_charge_mechanism
checks.expression: tax_charge_mechanism IN ('normal','reverse_charge') AND ((tax_charge_mechanism='normal' AND recipient_assessed_tax_total=0) OR (tax_charge_mechanism='reverse_charge' AND recipient_assessed_tax_total=cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total))

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_orders_tax_component_totals
checks.expression: ((supply_type='intra_state') AND igst_total=0 AND cgst_total=sgst_total) OR ((supply_type IN ('inter_state','import','sez')) AND cgst_total=0 AND sgst_total=0)

cross_row_invariants.name: procurement_purchase_orders_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Approval recomputes typed product and charge lines and header amounts under calculation_ruleset_version, validates effective HSN/SAC tax versions on order_date, and freezes approved commercial terms. Header net_value_total and gst_taxable_total must equal their rounded line sums. Persist document_discount_kind, document_discount_basis, and document_discount_value; discount_total must equal line_discount_amount plus allocated document_discount_amount across lines. zero_rated taxability is valid only for a qualifying inward supply to an SEZ recipient: zero_rated_payment_mode without_payment requires zero GST, while with_igst requires IGST only and preserves refund context. rounding_policy is immutable and pre-round net value plus tax components plus rounding_adjustment must equal grand_total. tax_charge_mechanism is uniform across lines: normal tax is part of counterparty grand_total; reverse_charge tax is excluded from payable and summed in recipient_assessed_tax_total.

tables.name: procurement.purchase_order_lines
tables.fact_owner: Ordered billed/free supplier quantities and expected price/tax calculation.

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_line_kind
checks.expression: line_kind IN ('product','charge')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_charge_code
checks.expression: charge_code IS NULL OR charge_code IN ('freight','packing','insurance','handling','other')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_price_basis
checks.expression: price_basis IN ('tax_exclusive','tax_inclusive')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_free_supply_tax_treatment
checks.expression: (line_kind='product' AND free_supply_tax_treatment IN ('excluded_from_taxable_value','included_at_unit_rate')) OR (line_kind='charge' AND free_supply_tax_treatment IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_uom_conversion
checks.expression: line_kind='charge' OR (base_billed_quantity=round(billed_quantity*uom_conversion_factor,6) AND base_free_quantity=round(free_quantity*uom_conversion_factor,6))

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_typed_payload
checks.expression: (line_kind='product' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND charge_code IS NULL AND uom_code IS NOT NULL AND uom_conversion_factor IS NOT NULL AND uom_conversion_factor>0 AND billed_quantity IS NOT NULL AND free_quantity IS NOT NULL AND base_billed_quantity IS NOT NULL AND base_free_quantity IS NOT NULL AND billed_quantity>=0 AND free_quantity>=0 AND billed_quantity+free_quantity>0 AND base_billed_quantity>=0 AND base_free_quantity>=0 AND base_billed_quantity+base_free_quantity>0 AND free_supply_tax_treatment IS NOT NULL AND quoted_unit_rate IS NOT NULL AND quoted_unit_rate>=0) OR (line_kind='charge' AND product_id IS NULL AND charge_code IS NOT NULL AND uom_code IS NULL AND uom_conversion_factor IS NULL AND billed_quantity IS NULL AND free_quantity IS NULL AND base_billed_quantity IS NULL AND base_free_quantity IS NULL AND free_supply_tax_treatment IS NULL AND quoted_unit_rate IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_money
checks.expression: gross_amount>=0 AND line_discount_amount>=0 AND line_taxable_discount_amount>=0 AND document_discount_amount>=0 AND document_taxable_discount_amount>=0 AND gst_taxable_value>=0 AND cgst_amount>=0 AND sgst_amount>=0 AND igst_amount>=0 AND cess_amount>=0 AND line_total>=0

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_tax_rates
checks.expression: cgst_rate>=0 AND sgst_rate>=0 AND igst_rate>=0 AND cess_rate>=0

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_line_discount_kind_basis
checks.expression: line_discount_kind IN ('none','percent','amount') AND line_discount_basis IN ('taxable_value','price_value') AND (line_kind<>'charge' OR line_discount_kind='none')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_line_discount_value
checks.expression: (line_discount_kind='none' AND line_discount_value=0) OR (line_discount_kind='percent' AND line_discount_value>=0 AND line_discount_value<=100) OR (line_discount_kind='amount' AND line_discount_value>=0 AND line_discount_value=round(line_discount_value,2))

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_discount_outputs
checks.expression: line_discount_amount>=0 AND line_taxable_discount_amount>=0 AND document_discount_amount>=0 AND document_taxable_discount_amount>=0 AND net_value_amount>=0 AND gst_taxable_value>=0 AND gst_taxable_value<=net_value_amount

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_taxability_snapshot
checks.expression: taxability_snapshot IN ('taxable','zero_rated','exempt','nil_rated','non_gst')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_taxability_value_shape
checks.expression: (taxability_snapshot IN ('taxable','zero_rated') AND gst_taxable_value=net_value_amount) OR (taxability_snapshot IN ('exempt','nil_rated','non_gst') AND gst_taxable_value=0 AND cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND igst_rate=0 AND cess_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND igst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_zero_rated_tax
checks.expression: taxability_snapshot<>'zero_rated' OR (cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND cess_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_tax_charge_mechanism
checks.expression: tax_charge_mechanism IN ('normal','reverse_charge') AND (tax_charge_mechanism<>'reverse_charge' OR (price_basis='tax_exclusive' AND taxability_snapshot<>'zero_rated' AND line_discount_basis='taxable_value'))

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_reverse_charge_payable
checks.expression: (tax_charge_mechanism='normal' AND line_total=net_value_amount+cgst_amount+sgst_amount+igst_amount+cess_amount) OR (tax_charge_mechanism='reverse_charge' AND line_total=net_value_amount)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_tax_component_shape
checks.expression: (igst_rate=0 AND cgst_rate=sgst_rate AND cgst_amount=sgst_amount) OR (cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_order_lines_withholding_nature
checks.expression: withholding_nature_code IS NULL OR btrim(withholding_nature_code)<>''

cross_row_invariants.name: procurement_purchase_order_lines_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: For product rows, derive base_billed_quantity and base_free_quantity from the immutable uom_conversion_factor at six-decimal precision. Recompute product quantities or typed charge amounts using the persisted tax-exclusive or tax-inclusive price_basis; apply the explicit free_supply_tax_treatment to product gross value, then discounts, taxable value, tax amounts, and line total. Reject tax_code_version_id outside its effective period. Only product lines may be received or allocated. Persist line discount kind/basis/value, document-discount eligibility and both nominal/taxable discount allocations; all outputs must match the canonical engine exactly. taxability_snapshot must match the effective tax-code default, except zero_rated is allowed only for qualifying SEZ inward-supply header context with preserved ITC/refund treatment. net_value_amount retains all pre-tax payable value while gst_taxable_value excludes exempt, nil-rated and non-GST value. For zero_rated lines, enforce the header mode: without_payment has zero components; with_igst permits only IGST and must match the effective rate. tax_charge_mechanism must equal the header; reverse_charge requires tax-exclusive pricing and pre-tax discount basis, records compliance tax components, and excludes those components from line_total. Intra-state component rates and rounded amounts have exact CGST=SGST equality; inter-state, import, or zero-rated-with-IGST has zero CGST and SGST.

cross_row_invariants.name: procurement_supplier_invoice_lines_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: For product rows, derive base_billed_quantity and base_free_quantity from the immutable uom_conversion_factor at six-decimal precision. Recompute product quantities or typed charge amounts using persisted price_basis and product free_supply_tax_treatment, then discounts, taxable value, tax amounts, and line total from the immutable HSN/SAC tax version and calculation ruleset. Posted price basis, UOM conversion, free-supply treatment, inventory_cost_treatment, net_value_account_id and itc_eligibility are immutable. Posting locks the active same-tenant asset/expense account selected by inventory_cost_treatment. Only product lines may allocate to goods receipts. Persist line discount kind/basis/value, document-discount eligibility and both nominal/taxable discount allocations; all outputs must match the canonical engine exactly. taxability_snapshot must match the effective tax-code default, except zero_rated is allowed only for qualifying SEZ inward-supply header context with preserved ITC/refund treatment. net_value_amount retains all pre-tax payable value while gst_taxable_value excludes exempt, nil-rated and non-GST value. Eligible ITC posts only to configured ITC assets; ineligible, blocked, or deferred tax follows inventory_cost_treatment and net_value_account_id without inferred credit. For zero_rated lines, enforce the header mode: without_payment has zero GST; with_igst permits only IGST. tax_charge_mechanism must equal the header; reverse_charge records compliance components and excludes those components from line_total while posting configured liability and treatment-directed debit. Intra-state component rates and rounded amounts have exact CGST=SGST equality; inter-state, import, or zero-rated-with-IGST has zero CGST and SGST.

checks.expression: gst_tax_treatment IN ('statutory','commercial_only') AND ((gst_tax_treatment='statutory' AND return_source_kind='invoiced' AND supplier_credit_note_portal_line_id IS NOT NULL) OR (gst_tax_treatment='commercial_only' AND supplier_credit_note_portal_line_id IS NULL AND gst_taxable_total=0 AND cgst_total=0 AND sgst_total=0 AND igst_total=0 AND cess_total=0 AND recipient_assessed_tax_total=0))

checks.name: ck_purchase_returns_totals
checks.expression: gst_taxable_total>=0 AND cgst_total>=0 AND sgst_total>=0 AND igst_total>=0 AND cess_total>=0 AND grand_total>=0

checks.name: ck_purchase_returns_posted
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('posted','reversed') OR (posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_returns_net_gst_totals
checks.expression: net_value_total>=0 AND gst_taxable_total>=0 AND gst_taxable_total<=net_value_total

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_returns_zero_rated_payment_mode
checks.expression: zero_rated_payment_mode IN ('not_applicable','without_payment','with_igst')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_returns_rounding_policy

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_returns_tax_charge_mechanism

indexes.name: ix_purchase_returns_supplier
indexes.purpose: Supplier debit and ITC reversal history.

cross_row_invariants.name: procurement_purchase_returns_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Posting locks return_source_kind and the exact active tax.gst_adjustment_rule_versions row for the purchase debit/decrease reason and return date. An invoiced return requires supplier_invoice_id, every line to reference an allocation from that invoice, and recomputes the commercial debit using its tax versions. The buyer-issued purchase debit remains distinct from supplier statutory evidence: statutory tax and ITC reversal require one locked imported tax.portal_document_lines credit_note matching the original supplier GSTIN, supplier credit-note number/date, place of supply and every rounded component; commercial_only creates no tax document and has zero GST components. It preserves zero_rated_payment_mode, without_payment, with_igst, tax_charge_mechanism, recipient_assessed_tax_total and rounding_policy from the original, carrying reverse-charge components as organization self-assessed tax. An uninvoiced return is commercial_only, forbids supplier-invoice allocations and supplier credit-note evidence, matches locked goods-receipt unit_cost and extended_cost exactly, and has zero GST. Posting freezes evidence and creates exactly one supplier-sourced tax document only for the statutory path, plus one payable adjustment, accounting event, and typed inventory issue. Header totals equal rounded line sums, rounding copies the original where invoiced, only final_residual may absorb deterministic residual, and cumulative reversal cannot exceed the locked source.

tables.name: procurement.purchase_return_lines
tables.fact_owner: Returned quantity for one accepted receipt lot and optional supplier-invoice allocation with tax reversal snapshot.

checks.name: ck_purchase_return_lines_quantity
checks.expression: billed_quantity>=0 AND free_quantity>=0 AND billed_quantity+free_quantity>0 AND uom_conversion_factor>0 AND base_billed_quantity>=0 AND base_free_quantity>=0 AND base_billed_quantity+base_free_quantity>0

checks.name: ck_purchase_return_lines_reversal_value_basis
checks.expression: reversal_value_basis IN ('billed_quantity','base_quantity')

checks.name: ck_purchase_return_lines_money
checks.expression: quoted_unit_rate>=0 AND gst_taxable_value>=0 AND cgst_amount>=0 AND sgst_amount>=0 AND igst_amount>=0 AND cess_amount>=0 AND line_total>=0

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_tax_rates
checks.expression: cgst_rate>=0 AND sgst_rate>=0 AND igst_rate>=0 AND cess_rate>=0

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_price_basis
checks.expression: price_basis IN ('tax_exclusive','tax_inclusive')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_free_supply_tax_treatment
checks.expression: free_supply_tax_treatment IN ('excluded_from_taxable_value','included_at_unit_rate')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_uom_conversion
checks.expression: base_billed_quantity=round(billed_quantity*uom_conversion_factor,6) AND base_free_quantity=round(free_quantity*uom_conversion_factor,6)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_billed_reversal_basis
checks.expression: reversal_value_basis<>'billed_quantity' OR billed_quantity>0

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_taxability_snapshot
checks.expression: taxability_snapshot IN ('taxable','zero_rated','exempt','nil_rated','non_gst')

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_taxability_value_shape
checks.expression: gst_tax_treatment IN ('statutory','commercial_only') AND net_value_amount>=0 AND gst_taxable_value>=0 AND ((gst_tax_treatment='commercial_only' AND gst_taxable_value=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND igst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0) OR (gst_tax_treatment='statutory' AND ((taxability_snapshot IN ('taxable','zero_rated') AND gst_taxable_value=net_value_amount) OR (taxability_snapshot IN ('exempt','nil_rated','non_gst') AND gst_taxable_value=0 AND cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND igst_rate=0 AND cess_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND igst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0))))

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_zero_rated_tax
checks.expression: taxability_snapshot<>'zero_rated' OR (cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND cess_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_tax_charge_mechanism
checks.expression: tax_charge_mechanism IN ('normal','reverse_charge') AND (tax_charge_mechanism<>'reverse_charge' OR (price_basis='tax_exclusive' AND taxability_snapshot<>'zero_rated'))

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_reverse_charge_payable
checks.expression: (tax_charge_mechanism='normal' AND line_total=net_value_amount+cgst_amount+sgst_amount+igst_amount+cess_amount) OR (tax_charge_mechanism='reverse_charge' AND line_total=net_value_amount)

checks.name: ck_procurement_purchase_return_lines_tax_component_shape
checks.expression: (igst_rate=0 AND cgst_rate=sgst_rate AND cgst_amount=sgst_amount) OR (cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0)

indexes.name: ix_purchase_return_lines_invoice_alloc
indexes.purpose: Invoiced quantity and ITC reversal ceiling.

cross_row_invariants.name: procurement_purchase_return_lines_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Under locked originals, an invoiced return may not exceed its supplier-invoice receipt allocation and must belong to the header supplier_invoice_id; an uninvoiced return may not exceed its goods-receipt line, copies locked unit_cost/extended_cost value, and has zero GST. Compute reversal ratio only from explicit reversal_value_basis; persisted final_residual must equal the consumed artifact. Tax version, product, batch, quoted_unit_rate, price_basis, free_supply_tax_treatment and tax snapshots match the debited original for invoiced returns. Persist quantities and UOM factor so no rounded quantity is inverted. zero_rated preserves without_payment or with_igst; tax_charge_mechanism reverse_charge excludes those components from line_total. Cumulative value and tax components cannot exceed the source.

checks.expression: status IN ('posted','reversed')

indexes.name: po_advance_allocations_line_idx

cross_row_invariants.name: purchase_order_advance_allocations_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the atomic supplier-advance payment/deduction or reversal command inserts rows. Lock the approved purchase order, product-kind line, supplier account, branch and INR disbursement; payment party must equal the supplier party. Active cash_disbursed_amount sums exactly to the bank payment, gross_advance_amount equals cash plus withholding, and each row creates one gross supplier-prepayment receivable and balanced accounting evidence. Goods advances carry no GST. A positive withholding component links the same atomic earlier-of-payment deduction. Reversal inserts compensating evidence and reverses the prepayment open item. Later supplier-invoice application locks the same PO line and prevents duplicate basis, withholding or reclassification.
